requirements_and_form: Clock Tower: bring 1 bucket of water for the hot black cog. Fill a bucket at the well by Cedric, east of the tower; a bucket also spawns there. The cogs and rat poison are found in the tower dungeon. Ice gloves are an optional substitute for the water bucket. Monk's Friend: bring 1 ordinary log + 1 jug of water . Chop a normal tree with your axe; buy a jug at a general store and fill it at a fountain/sink. Cedric needs a jug, so the Clock Tower bucket is the wrong container. The child's blanket is recovered in the quest's cave. Hazeel Cult: no outside quest item purchases. The cult-side path avoids a fight and obtains poison from Clivet and the key/scroll from the Carnillean house. If you choose the Ceril branch, bring your starter weapon and food for the quest fight; finish the butler-evidence ending and final conversation, rather than stopping at the first small payment. Full completion awards 2,000 coins and 1,500 Thieving XP. | Plague City groceries: use the Hazeel reward for 1 dwellberries, 1 chocolate dust and 1 bucket of milk from Hudo's Grand Tree Groceries (normally 12 coins total). Walk north-west from Ardougne to the Tree Gnome Stronghold's southern gate, continue north to the Grand Tree, climb one floor above ground and find Hudo in the north-west corner. The shop needs no Grand Tree quest completion or spirit-tree unlock. Wait for stock or use another world if needed. Plague City tools and water: bring 1 rope, a spade, the three groceries and the 1 snape grass picked before sailing. Buy a missing rope at Aemad's Adventuring Supplies in East Ardougne; a spade and an empty bucket spawn by Edmond's house in north-west East Ardougne. The garden needs four uses of a bucket of water : refill that bucket at the house's sink between uses, or bring four filled buckets. Alrena makes the gas mask from the dwellberries. For Bravek's cure, add chocolate dust to the milk, then add the snape grass. Finish the quest and keep the mask; replace it from the cupboard in Edmond's house if lost. The grass has now been consumed, separately from future prayer potions. Biohazard fight: bring the retained gas mask, starter bronze sword (or your axe), wooden shield if still owned, and 10 whole cakes . Hazeel Cult already covers the 5 Thieving needed to steal these cakes in the market. The quest supplies the medical gown, bird feed, pigeon cage, key, distillator and samples as you progress. Its upstairs level-13 Mourner has 19 HP and a max hit of 2 : start at full HP, use ordinary melee and eat back toward full around 6 HP on a fresh account. If the fight is dragging, retreat downstairs while at least two cakes remain, restock and return. This is a food buffer, not a new combat-level or prayer-flicking requirement; leave at least four inventory spaces for quest items. Biohazard delivery and clothes: Captain Barnaby at the East Ardougne docks sails to Rimmington for 30 coins ; budget another 30 for the return after the Varrock delivery. Hand the three chemicals to the Chemist's helpers as directed, then travel to south-east Varrock and recover them there. Teleporting does not destroy the chemicals or plague sample. Ask Asyff , in the clothes shop just north of the Dancing Donkey Inn, for the free priest top and bottom during the quest. If that once-free set was already claimed and lost, buy replacements for 12 coins . Finish with Elena and King Lathas, then rebank for the diary. Keep the gas mask afterwards for Desert Treasure. These are separate quest inventories. Count items actually retained, use the completed quests' coins for the purchases, and replace food consumed before starting the next activity. Plague City · Biohazard . | Prepare the sword: after Biohazard, check actual 15 Thieving and take food to the H.A.M. hideout north-west of Lumbridge . Picklock the trapdoor, descend and pickpocket female H.A.M. members until you actually receive one rusty sword . This is a random drop, so there is no fixed pickpocket count. One sword is required; a second is optional insurance. Carry 100 coins per identification attempt (200 is a small two-attempt buffer), plus the diary silk and separate boat fares. This sword source needs 15 Thieving; the diary itself only needs 5. Take an ordinary return boat to Ardougne, then bank between the town, southern and lever tasks. Sell the bought silk: give the East Ardougne silk merchant one unnoted silk for 60 coins , asking for 120 first and accepting 60 after his counteroffer. Do this before stealing silk in the next route step. If you already stole silk recently, spend ten consecutive minutes outside Ardougne without logging out before trying again; buying a fresh piece does not cancel his refusal. Steal a cake: successfully steal an actual cake from a market bakery stall at 5 Thieving. If the earlier food pickup already ticked the diary entry, it is done. Cromperty: right-click Teleport Wizard Cromperty in north-east East Ardougne to enter the rune essence mine, then leave through its portal. Rune Mysteries is complete; no pickaxe or mining is required. Town church altar: switch on Thick Skin until a Prayer point drains, then pray at the East Ardougne church . This task uses the church in town, not the monastery altar. Probita: right-click Check Probita in East Ardougne to inspect insured pets. You do not need a pet or an insurance payment. Combat Training Camp: after Biohazard, enter its gate north of West Ardougne . No fight or ranged equipment is needed for the entry task. Fishing Trawler: walk to Port Khazard , board Murphy's boat on an official Fishing Trawler world and wait for it to depart and the task to tick. No Fishing level, successful catch or Angler outfit is required. After credit, ask Murphy to return to shore, then use a barrel to reach the shore north of Port Khazard, then walk south to the docks; keep a little HP for the swim. You do not need repair supplies for this departure-only trip. Tindel Marchant: at the southern Port Khazard dock, pay 100 coins to identify the rusty sword. Talking alone is insufficient. A rare junk result fails the task: obtain another rusty sword and pay another 100 coins if that happens. Aleck: walk south-west to Yanille and open Aleck's Hunter Emporium. No purchase or Hunter level is required. Wilderness lever: return to an Ardougne bank and deposit everything in the inventory and every equipped item . Pull the lever west of the castle into deep Wilderness, then immediately pull the arrival lever to return. Stay inside the enclosure; no knife is needed for this return. Re-equip and withdraw supplies afterwards. Check all ten entries in the Easy Diary list , then claim the reward from Two-pints in the Flying Horse Inn , north of the castle in north-west East Ardougne. The reward is Ardougne cloak 1 and a 2,500-XP lamp ; Two-pints replaces a lost cloak for free.

requirements_and_form: 12 magic logs: use the protected Woodcutting/Wintertodt stock and withdraw the twelve noted for Eblis . If fewer remain, cut the missing logs at 75 Woodcutting; return to the opening Woodcutting step for that conditional gate. This quest spends twelve of the chapter's thirteen-log allocation; keep the last log banked for Mourning's End Part I. Chapter 3.1's While Guthix Sleeps supplies the later MM2 balloon logs from its storeroom loot. 6 steel bars + 1 iron bar: check the bank after clockworks, other quests and smithing. At 30 Smithing, smelt six iron ore with twelve coal into steel at an ordinary furnace; make the separate iron bar at 15 Smithing, allowing for failed iron smelts. Mine the ore or buy it from Ordan in Keldagrim. Six iron ore alone is not six steel bars. Withdraw the six steel bars noted for Eblis ; keep the separate iron bar for the boots stage. 6 molten glass: withdraw the reserved glass as one noted stack of six molten glass for Eblis . It must remain molten glass. If it was blown into something else, replace it with six fresh buckets of sand and six soda ash from a charter trader, smelted at a furnace at 1 Crafting. Unpowered orbs cannot be converted back into glass. 1 silver bar: a fresh bar after Shadow of the Storm, Nature Spirit, Fenkenstrain and Animal Magnetism. Buy the shortfall from the East Ardougne Silver Merchant; do not assume one reserved bar survived all five consumers. Ashes / bones / blood rune: burn a normal log and collect its ashes; kill a chicken for ordinary bones; if already at 63 Magic, drink a Wizard's mind bomb to enter the 66-Magic Wizards' Guild in Yanille and buy a blood rune upstairs; otherwise buy it from Ali Morrisane after The Feud and Rogue Trader's rune-shop puzzle, or Lundail's shop using 1.3's bank-first Wilderness approach. A rune shop without blood-rune stock is not a supplier. Charcoal / garlic powder / spice / sweet: buy charcoal from Jiminua north-west of Tai Bwo Wannai, take garlic from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's Draynor house and grind it, buy spice from Ardougne's spice seller, and buy a chocolate bar from the Grand Tree groceries. Keep that sweet separate from chocolate dust used in energy potions. Boots: take one spare climbing-boot pair from Death Plateau, or buy it from Tenzing for 12 coins. Bring it and the separate iron bar to Dunstan in Burthorpe for spiked boots when the ice-path stage calls for them. Keep an ordinary climbing pair available for mountain travel. Desert entry: Shantay at the pass south of Al Kharid sells passes and filled waterskins. Buy passes for the gate crossings you actually plan to make, or use an existing desert-entry bypass; carry waterskins for exposed walks. Keep carpet fares separate from the 650-coin Bandit Camp pub payment, and refill travel supplies before another desert trip. Gas mask / tinderbox / lockpicks: use Plague City's mask; reclaim it from the cupboard in Edmond's house if lost. Buy a tinderbox from a general store. At the route's 50+ Agility/Thieving, buy lockpicks from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den beneath Burthorpe's Toad and Chicken . Start with about 50 and replenish if unlucky; this is a buffer, not a guaranteed lock count. Bring antipoison and food for the trapped chest. The archaeologist/Rasolo and other quest NPCs supply the etchings, translation, visibility ring, keys and diamonds during their respective stages. For Dessous, first ask Malak in the Canifis pub how to kill him ; Ruantun will not make the pot before that dialogue. Then take the silver bar to Ruantun in Draynor Sewers for the silver pot , bank weapons/armour for Entrana and have its High Priest bless it, return to Malak for blood, and add the garlic powder and ordinary spice. Check that the finished pot contains blood, garlic and spices before going to the graveyard. Bank completed diamonds between trips. Keep the gas mask equipped throughout the Smoke Dungeon . | Count doses and missing ingredients now. A normal Herblore craft makes three doses . Decant by using matching potions on one another, or ask Bob Barter at the Grand Exchange to decant to four-dose vials; decanting changes bottles, not the total doses. Water-filled vials are sold individually or in packs by Aemad in East Ardougne and Herblore shops. Prayer potion — 38 Herblore: clean ranarr + vial of water + snape grass. For the nine prayer(4) planning stock below, twelve crafts use 12 ranarrs, 12 snape grass and 12 water-filled vials and make 36 doses . Count the live bank and pick only the missing grass on the hobgoblin peninsula west of the Crafting Guild , outside the guild; bring food and a Falador/bank teleport. Farming snape grass is not required. Reserve Eadgar's separate ranarr first if that quest is unfinished. Ordinary restore — 22 Herblore: clean harralander + vial of water + red spiders' eggs . For the separate troll and Kamil trips, start by making 6 restore(3) = 18 doses , requiring 6 harralanders and 6 eggs . Reserve 12 doses = 3 restore(4) for the Kamil boss trip; the other six doses are the opening troll-trip pool. After decanting the full stock, that is four restore(4) plus one restore(2). Refill anything consumed before taking the full boss reserve. These restore drained combat stats including Magic, but not Prayer, Hitpoints or Agility . Keep the additional Heroes' Quest harralander banked. Missing eggs: enter Varrock Sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace , follow the sewer west to the moss-giant/deadly-red-spider end, and pick the red-spiders'-eggs ground spawns. Bring a knife or slash weapon for webs, food and a bank teleport. Pick up respawns until you have the six missing eggs; killing the spiders is unnecessary. At 51 Agility , the pipe near Vannaka connects Edgeville Dungeon to these sewers as an alternative. Stay out of Edgeville's separate Wilderness section. Energy potion — 26 Herblore: clean harralander + water-filled vial + chocolate dust. Use already-made energy potions first; otherwise buy chocolate bars from Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree and crush them with a pestle and mortar. Each new energy potion needs an additional herb after the six restore herbs and Heroes' reserve. For an opening travel/kiting buffer from zero, make three energy(3) from three additional herbs and three chocolate dust: decant eight doses into two energy(4), leaving one spare dose. Walking while run energy regenerates and banking between legs reduces demand; replace only what you use. Antipoison — 5 Herblore: buy ordinary antipoison(3) directly from Jiminua's Jungle Store , or mix clean marrentill + water-filled vial + unicorn horn dust. If making it, kill a unicorn south of Varrock and grind its horn. Start with two three-dose bottles in the bank, taking one for the trapped chest/pyramid legs and replacing it if spent. If herbs are missing: use banked clean/grimy herbs and suitable already-planted herbs first. For an immediate repeatable source, take combat gear, food and a Falador/bank teleport to Taverley Dungeon's chaos druids near the entrance, kill them for herb drops and bank until the actual named shortfall is filled. This is a random drop hunt, not a promised number of kills. Do not process every harralander into energy potions before reserving the restore ingredients. No Farming-contract reward is treated as guaranteed. Super restores are different: they need 63 Herblore, snapdragon and red spiders' eggs and restore Prayer as well as drained stats. Ordinary restores and prayer potions are separate supplies. Both recipes are available once you have 38 Herblore ; there is no 63-Herblore detour for this quest. How much to bring: bank the full available prayer stock, then take the per-boss amounts below. With that nine-bottle planning stock, keep four prayer(4) earmarked for the ice-troll/Kamil attempt and use the other five as a starting pool for the remaining legs. Amounts depend on damage, prayer bonus, mistakes and retries; if the bank falls below the next leg's buffer, replenish it before entering. Replenish an insufficient potion bank before the next leg rather than relying on learning flicking during the quest. It later explicitly spends prayer potions and death runes on DT, alongside high-attention boss methods. BRUHsailer source . | Use the standard spellbook for the four bosses. Bank the staff for this method; if you choose to wield one initially, leave a free inventory slot for it when disarmed. For the lower-damage alternative, bring energy potions, cast once and run around the room to keep distance. If he catches you, the three inventory rune stacks still let you keep manual casting. Banking/retrying is preferable to running out of water runes mid-fight. Set up while the first form is alive; use a weak hit only if needed to get the blocker following you. Leave Protect from Melee on during the lure. Once the blocker is actually holding Damis and you are taking no attacks, cast from that position and turn prayer off. Keep the block for the second form; do not run so far away that the encounter resets. If the blocker moves or dies, put Protect from Melee back on and re-establish it or teleport. Use the current Damis positioning illustration for the exact layout instead of guessing a tile from a textual direction. | Bring the completed blessed blood mixture, combat runes, 2 prayer(4) , plenty of food and a teleport.
