Phoenix Gang: bring Ranged or Magic to kill the target through the mansion window. Keep any black armour for King's Ransom. If the reserved harralander is gone, use the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery to obtain another clean herb and vial of water. Gerrant's Port Sarim fishing shop supplies the normal rod, bait and, after the quest conversation, blamish snail slime . Combine harralander with the vial of water, add the slime, and apply the resulting oil to the rod. Without the 70-Agility shortcut, kill Taverley Dungeon's jailer for his jail key and free Velrak the explorer to obtain a dusty key. The Ice Queen is under White Wolf Mountain: bring a pickaxe for the 50-Mining rock obstacle, food and combat supplies. Keep her ice gloves; they are the glove requirement, with no Smiths' gloves grind.

quest_or_step: Complete Monkey Madness I and take Daero's Attack/Defence reward
requirements_and_form: 1 gold bar; 1 ball of wool; 5 bananas (quest garden); ordinary Karamjan monkey bones/corpse; quest-local dentures, M'amulet mould and monkey talisman; their replacement also specified
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Smelt one fresh gold bar from Ordan's gold ore if Between a Rock used the last four. Shear one sheep and spin its wool at Lumbridge castle for the ball of wool; the small-material suppliers also covers missing moulds and tools. Obtain Karamjan monkey bones by killing a normal monkey on Karamja before travelling, and collect the five bananas in the quest garden. Lost M'speak amulet: collect new monkey dentures from the stacked crates in the house south of Marim's marketplace . Search that house's south-east crate to enter the cavern, then the north-west crate for the M'amulet mould . Take dentures, mould and a fresh gold bar to Zooknock at the end of the southern Ape Atoll tunnel . Take his enchanted bar and the returned mould to the wall of flame beneath the Temple of Marimbo , make the unstrung amulet, and add one ball of wool. This same process replaces an amulet after the quest. The first monkey talisman comes from the monkey child during this quest. Keep the finished M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree for Awowogei. Refill prayer and antipoison via the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery and bank between dangerous trips; a previously recommended potion is not a dose still in your inventory.

requirements_and_form: 1 iron bar; 1 ordinary log; 1 non-silver ring that is consumed (plain gold ring default); 1 reputation tool (axe/pickaxe/rake/fishing tool); axe default; flowers, prince's cake and princess's bow are optional gifts, despite QH required-array placement
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The iron bar and ring are consumed . Smelt iron ore until you have one iron bar, and make a plain gold ring from one gold bar and a ring mould at a furnace (5 Crafting). Ordan's ore stock and Dommik's moulds are covered in the small-material suppliers . Use an ordinary gold ring rather than assuming every enchanted, silver or high-tier ring is accepted. Cut the one ordinary log locally and use your axe for approval afterward. Courting gifts only speed the dialogue: the castle courtyard's Flower Girl sells mixed flowers, and a cheap ordinary bow from Lowe works for the princess if you want that extra gift. They are not an additional completion requirement.

quest_or_step: Fund and assign the first ten kingdom workers
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Speak to Advisor Ghrim after the quest. Put roughly 1,000,000 coins in the coffer if the 2.1 battlestaff cash reserve permits; 500,000 is the minimum balance for the current maximum 50,000 gp daily draw. If cash is tighter, deposit what you can and top up from later alchs rather than postponing the unlock. This spends GP for account resources, not for Grand Exchange profit. Assign all ten available workers to herbs. The route still needs 70 Herblore, so this starts a valuable, resource-gated supply early. Keep approval reasonably high: it falls by about 2.5 percentage points per day before Royal Trouble. Revisit when convenient, chop a few maples or use another nearby approval action, and let the system run while you do Slayer. There is no daily alarm or requirement to collect every day. Wiki coffer and worker mechanics.

quest_or_step: Train Slayer from the current level to actual 40
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Why 40: Royal Trouble requires it now; the Chapter 1 handoff was only about 20+. Check the actual skill tab, take ordinary Slayer tasks, and stop at unboosted 40. This is not a 51-Slayer grind for Troubled Tortugans yet. Default master: Vannaka in Edgeville Dungeon, east of the Wilderness gate, accepts combat level 40+. An Edgeville teleport or fairy ring DKR brings you near the dungeon; speak to him for an assignment, check the monster and location in the Slayer interface, bank for food/prayer/teleports, then kill the assigned number and return for another task. A higher master is fine only if your observed combat level supports it comfortably. Task sequence and XP vary by RNG. You do not need a cannon, burst runes or a special task list. Check each monster's required gear before leaving: for example, earmuffs for banshees and a mirror shield for cockatrices/basilisks; Slayer masters sell many such items. Save points where possible. If an assignment is truly miserable, a normal cancellation costs 30 Slayer points when you have them; asking Turael in Burthorpe to replace a task is an emergency escape but resets the normal task streak. Do not reset a valuable streak for routine inconvenience. Wiki masters, equipment and task mechanics. Use the combat XP deliberately: check post-2.2 Attack/Strength/Defence, then use an appropriate style to advance whichever later gate is lagging—Attack + Strength 130 for Warriors' Guild, actual 60 Defence to equip the dragon defender, then 6...
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Complete Royal Trouble at actual 40 Slayer
requirements_and_form: 5 coal OR a pickaxe to mine the coal beside the lift; combat supplies; 2 ropes plus other lift/scaffold items obtained from quest crates
supplier_or_recovery_summary: If the bank lacks coal, bring your pickaxe and mine five coal in the lift room during the quest. Take two ropes from its rope crate : one repairs the scaffold and the other makes the later rope swing. These are actual quest-local sources; you do not need to assume two ropes survived Underground Pass. Rebank before the sea-snake section and refill food, antipoison and prayer doses using the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery . The lift materials do not replace the boss supplies.

quest_or_step: Set the improved kingdom to fifteen useful workers
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Royal Trouble raises the workforce to 15 and the maximum coffer draw to 75,000 gp per day. Maintain at least 750,000 gp for full daily spending; a comfortable balance is roughly 1.5–2 million if the 2.1 cash engine permits. Top up when collecting or passing through, not on a rigid daily schedule. Approval now falls about 1 percentage point per day; restore it periodically with maple chopping or another easy island task. Default allocation: ten herbs + five hardwood/teak workers. Herbs support the later 70-Herblore bottleneck; teak logs can become planks for the later 70-Construction block. Check your leftover 2.1 teak stock before committing: if Construction is well supplied but seeds/nests would help Farming, move those five workers to maples instead. The allocation is adjustable, including before collection, and no workers should sit idle. It is an Ironman resource decision, not a fixed GE-profit formula. Wiki resource categories and collection.

requirements_and_form: 208 coins for barcrawl drinks; travel extra; barcrawl card quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Why: Horror from the Deep needs the Barcrawl, and full Recipe for Disaster needs Horror. Go to the Barbarian Outpost (games necklace), talk to the Barbarian guard at the agility-course gate and take the barcrawl card. Alfred Grimhand is the namesake of the challenge, not this starting guard. Carry the card, about 1,000 coins, food and your normal teleports. Ask each bartender for the special drink; ordinary beer does not stamp the card. Some drinks drain stats or Hitpoints, especially the Ardougne Heart Stopper, so heal between pubs and do not combine this with a boss trip. Use a compact regional circuit, in whichever direction your teleports favor: Seers' Forester's Arms → Ardougne Flying Horse → Yanille Dragon Inn → Brimhaven Dead Man's Chest and Musa Point Karamja Spirits → Port Sarim Rusty Anchor and Falador Rising Sun → Varrock Blue Moon and Jolly Boar → Grand Tree Blurberry Bar. That is the ten required pubs, not ten copies of one drink. Check every stamp on the card, then return to the Barbarian guard at the Outpost for the completed miniquest and agility-course access. Wiki pub list and drink effects.

quest_or_step: Complete Horror from the Deep and choose a damaged god book
requirements_and_form: 1 each air, water, earth and fire rune for door; 1 ordinary sword to sacrifice (bronze sword default); 1 metal arrow to sacrifice; 1 molten glass; 1 tinderbox; 1 hammer; 60 steel nails; 2 regular planks; 1 swamp tar; 20+ casts of each elemental combat spell recommended by QH; fight supplies separate from door offerings
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Use the small-material suppliers for two regular planks, 60 steel nails and one molten glass . Collect one swamp tar from Lumbridge Swamp and keep your tinderbox. The same glass cannot be reserved for both this lamp and a later clockwork bench or Wanted! commorb. Buy a cheap bronze sword from Varrock's sword shop and one plain bronze arrow from Lowe for the door. A dagger or scimitar is not a sword offering. Buy one of each elemental rune from Aubury for the other four symbols, then carry a separate stack of combat runes and ammunition. Refill the trip's potion recipes and missing-stock recovery if necessary.

quest_or_step: Complete Pandemonium and learn the raft controls
requirements_and_form: 1 hammer and 1 saw, both obtainable from shipyard crates; quest-provided logs/boat materials and Captain's log
supplier_or_recovery_summary: No pre-quest material stock is required. If you do not have a hammer and saw, take them from the labelled tool crates in the shipyard when the tutorial reaches that stage. Junior Jim provides the Captain's log, and the quest supplies the raft and starter repair kits. Keep these tools and supplies for Prying Times and the first Sailing trips.

quest_or_step: Use early port tasks and charting to reach actual 12 Sailing
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Start at the notice board in Port Sarim or The Pandemonium. A courier port task names cargo and a destination: accept it, collect the crate at the origin's ledger table, put it in your boat's cargo hold, sail and dock at the destination, unload it at that port's ledger, then claim the reward. At level 1 you can hold one task, rising to two at level 7. The short Port Sarim–Pandemonium trips teach the loop; Musa Point routes open around level 10. Tasks can be cancelled if a route is inconvenient, so no particular random assignment is required. Sea charting is one-time exploration XP, not a repeatable click spot. Open the Captain's log's charts, pick an accessible nearby observation, sail to its marked feature and click/inspect it; for spyglass tasks, use the spyglass from the indicated viewpoint. Some simple targets merely require passing through or interacting with scenery. Claim sea-completion bonuses from Chartin' Charles McAtless in the Pandemonium Cave with the log when available. Noticeable ocean encounters or mysterious glows encountered along the way can add XP; treat them as bonuses rather than a fixed quota. Alternate courier deliveries and new chart targets until the skill tab shows actual 12. Wiki charting task types.

quest_or_step: Complete Prying Times and retain the crowbar
requirements_and_form: 1 hammer; 1 steel bar; 1 whole redberry pie; 1 Captain's log
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count one whole redberry pie and one steel bar . For the bar, smelt one iron ore plus two coal. For the pie, get flour from Wydin in Port Sarim, redberries from the bushes southeast of Varrock, and water; make pastry dough, put it in a pie dish, add the berries and cook it on a range (10 Cooking). If the pie burns, repeat until one cooked pie is banked. Make a pie dish from soft clay at Rimmington's wheel and pottery oven (7 Crafting) if you need one. The guild shop remains an alternative if you already have a chef's hat. Take the hammer from the Pandemonium shipyard crate if missing, and recover your Captain's log through Junior Jim. If you lose Thurgo's key, the replacement consumes another pie and steel bar; recount them before returning.

With the crowbar, revisit the Captain's log and clear reachable sealed-crate/forgotten-drink observations while doing convenient courier tasks. At 15 Sailing, a skiff becomes available from a shipwright for 15,000 coins. It is a larger, more comfortable boat and can take a salvaging hook: sail beside a small shipwreck, deploy the hook to recover salvage for XP, store it in the cargo hold, then sort it at a port's salvaging station for more XP and materials. A raft can also be fitted with a hook; the skiff is convenient, not the unlock itself. Buy/fit it if you want variety or a better boat for later; charting and couriers remain valid if the cash or materials would be better saved. Use the Captain's log to pick attainable nearby charting, take tasks where they naturally connect ports, and notice ocean encounters without turning every sea tile into a required stop. Reach actual 22 Sailing, then do the quest below. Wiki salvage loop.

quest_or_step: Complete Current Affairs and learn current charting
requirements_and_form: 1 charcoal, obtainable during quest; 50 coins
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Check actual 22 Sailing, 10 Fishing and Pandemonium; Fishing is already well above the gate. Bring 50 coins, with charcoal if banked (or take it from the Catherby council office), and have your boat at the Catherby dock. Speak to Arhein there, work through Councillor Catherine's form and the fish-mayor errand, then sail to the nearby current and use Arhein's current duck to trace it. This teaches a new charting action rather than requiring guesswork at random ripples. Wiki quest route. Finish with Arhein for 1,400 Sailing XP, 1,000 Fishing XP, the current duck and 25 oak-plank sawmill coupons. Keep the duck with the charting tools; its current-tracking entries expand the one-time charting pool.

quest_or_step: Sail in useful bands to actual 45, then stop
supplier_or_recovery_summary: 22–29: use the new current-duck entries, leftover crowbar/spyglass observations, convenient courier jobs, and skiff salvage if you built it. The log shows attainable chart targets; collect completed sea bonuses from Charles. Bounty tasks begin at 30, but nothing here requires ship combat or a cannon. 30–37: Barracuda Trials open at 30—repeatable Sailing obstacle courses in which you steer around hazards and collect cargo under rank conditions. The first, Tempor Tantrum, is an active/faster change of pace, not a mandatory grind. To try it, use a skiff equipped with an iron helm, oak mast and linen sails; check the live Shipyard schematic before spending resources. One-time rank rewards can be worthwhile, but repeated trials and their timing challenges are not the price of reaching 45. At 31, a teak hull is a useful skiff speed upgrade; your 2.1 Construction exceeds its level gate, but the hull still consumes materials (roughly 50 teak planks plus fittings). A shipwright can help with a missing Construction level, not waive materials. If your teak stock is earmarked for later Construction, stay with the current hull and keep charting/couriers instead. Wiki trials · Wiki ship schematics. 38–45: level 38 opens mermaid-guide charting; follow the Captain's log's high-30s observations and finish the accessible Ardent/Sunset sea collections for their one-time completion XP. Fill any remaining gap with ordinary courier tasks, charting, salvage or encounters that you enjoy. The publ...
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

requirements_and_form: 1 raw tuna; 7 coal at actual Mining 2–54 OR 6 mithril ore at 55+ (8 tin only at Mining1, below route floor); 10 arctic pine logs total if new shield needed: 8 split logs for bridges +2 for shield; 9 ropes if new shield needed: 8 bridges +1 shield; 1 bronze nail for shield; 1 hammer; 1 axe; 1 knife; 1 needle; 1 thread; 15 coins to cure three yak hides; 3 yak hides collected locally, crafted into top+legs; jester outfit quest-local; food/combat supplies
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy the raw tuna from Flosi in east Jatizso , or fish it with a harpoon at the pier. The route's minimum Mining level is 50, which means seven coal ; an account already at 55+ is asked for six mithril ore instead. Mine the missing ore in the underground mine northwest of Jatizso, or buy it from Ordan before travelling. Coal and mithril bars are not interchangeable with the requested ore. Buy missing ropes from Ned and a needle/thread from Dommik. Smith one bronze bar into bronze nails at an anvil if no nail remains. Cut ten arctic-pine logs in total when making everything: split eight at Neitiznot's central woodcutting stump for the two bridges, and keep two unsplit for the shield. Kill local yaks for three hides , pay Thakkrad beside Mawnis five coins per hide to cure them, and sew the two-hide top and one-hide legs. Check the shield and both armour pieces before the troll trip.

quest_or_step: Train Mining from actual 50 to actual 60
supplier_or_recovery_summary: This is a hard Lunar Diplomacy gate: 60 Mining is not boostable. Read your live level after 2.2; train only the remainder and stop at actual 60. No ore quota or 72-Mining checkpoint is hidden here. Shooting Stars are the low-attention choice: locate a landed star via the in-game/world-tracking community, bring a pickaxe, mine a tier your level permits and move to the next star when it depletes. The 2,000 stardust Chapter 1 set aside already bought the celestial ring; any new dust is a bonus. Motherlode Mine is the resource-minded choice: mine pay-dirt, deposit it in the hopper, collect ore from the sack and bank it for later Smithing. It asks for more movement but turns this level gate into useful metal stock. If you independently unlocked Cam Torum, calcified deposits are another relaxed option; do not complete Perilous Moons just to enter them. Wiki Mining methods.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Verify actual 65 Magic and complete Lunar Diplomacy
requirements_and_form: 1 bullseye lantern (can reuse sapphire body, unlight/refit quest lens); 400 coins; 1 tinderbox; 1 guam leaf; 1 marrentill; 1 dramen staff; access to Air, Fire, Water, Earth altars in that order; 1 pickaxe; 1 pestle and mortar; 1 hammer; 1 needle +2 thread OR costume needle; 1 spade; quest-local special vial/lens/suqah materials
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Extinguish the bullseye or sapphire lantern before fitting the quest's emerald lens, then relight it. If the body is missing, buy a replacement from Miltog in Dorgesh-Kaan and fuel it with Lumbridge swamp tar at the adjacent still. Keep the removed sapphire/lens. Dommik sells the needle and thread; the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery includes an actual way to replace one guam and one marrentill . The Oneiromancer provides the special potion vial; four Suqah hides and the tooth come from the quest's Suqah kills. Altar access is a real item check: take an air, fire, water and earth talisman/tiara already in the bank, and use the dramen staff at the altars in air → fire → water → earth order. For missing talismans, the matching elemental wizards south of Falador, northwest of Port Sarim, can drop them; kill only the needed type until its talisman is obtained, without assuming a fixed kill count. The already-unlocked Abyss is the alternative to collecting talismans. The Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville is in the Wilderness, and entry drains Prayer and normally skulls you: bank valuables, take the staff plus a cheap pickaxe and teleport, and use the appropriate inner rift. Rebank and restore Prayer before later combat. If the dramen staff was lost, get a new branch from the Entrana dungeon tree and use a knife on it; bank prohibited equipment for the boat and obtain an axe from the dungeon zombies.

quest_or_step: Complete Big Chompy Bird Hunting and keep its gear
requirements_and_form: 1 axe; 100 feathers; 1 knife; 1 chisel; 4 wolf bones; 1 each cabbage, tomato, onion, potato, equa leaves, doogle leaves; all available locally; quest-local achey logs, bellows, ogre bow; ammo crafted during quest
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy 100 feathers from Gerrant's fishing shop in Port Sarim. Kill four wolves for their wolf bones ; White Wolf Mountain has lower-level wolves if the level-64 Feldip ones are uncomfortable. Use your axe and knife on local achey trees/logs for shafts, attach the feathers, chisel the bones into arrow tips, and finish the arrows. The family chooses from quest-local onion, tomato, potato, cabbage, equa leaves and doogle leaves . Follow the requested ingredients: onion/tomato/cabbage/doogle are west of Rantz, while potato/equa are southeast. The bellows come from the cave chest. Catch and bank a separate raw chompy for Skrach after Rantz's cooked bird has been handed in.

requirements_and_form: 1 empty pot; flour from mansion barrel, flypaper from west shed and investigation items quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Go to Sinclair Mansion north of Seers' Village and speak to the guard. Bring one empty pot (buy a replacement from Lumbridge's general store). There is no combat; the kitchen flour barrel supplies flour for your pot and the west shed's sacks supply flypaper: collect the dagger, thread, poison and suspect evidence in the mansion, use flour/flypaper for fingerprints, then present the matching case. Keep it as one investigation rather than splicing it into other errands. It supplies three Quest Points and closes both the Lumbridge Guide and later King's Ransom prerequisites. Wiki evidence walkthrough.

quest_or_step: Complete Cold War for the later Weiss quest
requirements_and_form: 10 unnoted oak planks; 10 steel nails; 1 hammer; 1 spade; 1 clockwork OR 1 steel bar to craft clockwork; 1 ordinary plank; 1 silk; 1 raw cod OR ring of Charos (a); 1 swamp tar; 5 feathers; 1 mahogany plank; 1 soft leather; Crafting table 3: upgrade existing table 2 with 2 molten glass at 34 Construction; if absent, table 1 needs 4 oak planks, table 2 needs 1 more molten glass.
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count 10 unnoted oak planks, 10 steel nails, one regular plank, one silk, one clockwork mechanism or steel bar, one swamp tar, five feathers, one mahogany plank and one leather . The small-material suppliers covers nails, glass, ordinary planks and steel; sawmill conversion costs 250 coins per oak plank and 1,500 per mahogany plank. Cut a mahogany log north of the Farming Guild if no log remains. Buy silk in Al Kharid, tan a cowhide with Ellis there for normal leather, and buy feathers from Gerrant. If no finished clockwork remains, use one steel bar on crafting table 2 or better to make it; then use the required table 3 for the penguin. This mechanism is separate from any clockworks still being used for birdhouses. Your activated ring of charos from Garden of Tranquillity can replace the raw-cod payment; without it, big-net fish at Catherby until you catch one raw cod . Keep the ring equipped for that dialogue, and collect the cowbell during the quest.

quest_or_step: Complete Tai Bwo Wannai Trio and unlock karambwans
requirements_and_form: 1 full Agility potion(4), consumed; 1 iron-or-better accepted spear, consumed (black/decorative exclusions apply); 1 small fishing net; 1 hammer; 1 pestle and mortar; 1 knife or sliced banana; 1 tinderbox; 2 logs OR axe to cut them; 30 coins or preprepared Karamjan rum; 1 sliced banana added to rum on Karamja; 1 jogre bones; seaweed and monkey corpse for quest cooking/skinning; 20 raw karambwanji for Lubufu PLUS more for bait/sauce; 1 raw karambwan for poison, more if burnt; Ranged/Magic to kill monkey
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy an iron-or-better spear from the Fortis Blacksmith if you do not own a suitable spear; a lucky jogre drop is a bonus, not the supply plan. Kill a jogre for its bones and a monkey with Magic or Ranged for the skin/corpse step. Collect seaweed from Karamja's shore, buy rum at Musa Point and pick a banana on its plantation; slice the banana with the knife and add it to the rum while still on Karamja. Catch more than the 20 karambwanji handed to Lubufu : the vessel needs bait and Tinsay's sauce needs more fish. After obtaining the vessel, keep fishing until the quest's raw karambwan and recipe ingredients are present. Follow the quest dialogue for burning the jogre bones and making the sauce. The Agility potion above must reach four doses after decanting ; a three-dose bottle cannot pay Tamayu.

quest_or_step: Complete One Small Favour; put both lamps into Herblore
requirements_and_form: 4 steel bars; 1 bronze bar; 1 iron bar; 1 chisel; 1 hammer; 2 guam leaves; 1 marrentill; 1 harralander; 1 empty cup; 1 bowl of hot water; 1 pot; pot lid made locally with additional clay; 5 pigeon cages bought from Jerico; gemstones supplied in quest, replacements bought after breakage
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Get the empty cup by drinking the tea in the house north of Sanfew in Taverley. Take a bowl from Lumbridge castle, fill it with water, then heat it on a range. Use the bowl of hot water on the empty cup , then add two guams, one marrentill and one harralander to make Guthix rest(3). Ordinary restore or prayer potions cannot replace this tea. Refill missing herbs through the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery . Use the small-material suppliers for four steel bars, one bronze bar, one iron bar, an empty pot and fresh soft clay . Take all five pigeon cages from behind Jerico's house in East Ardougne. When the quest teaches pot lids, shape one from soft clay at a pottery wheel and fire it in the pottery oven; make a second only if you are reserving it for Swan Song. The gnome lamps provide uncut opal, jade, red topaz and sapphire . Cut and replace those; if a gem is crushed, buy another from Gnormadium Avlafrim at the landing strip or mine replacements at Shilo. Bring a few thousand coins for the repair fallback rather than assuming every old quest gem remains.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 62 Cooking for Swan Song
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Swan Song asks for 62 Cooking. Tai Bwo Wannai Trio's claimed 5,000 Cooking XP helps, but does not guarantee the level from Chapter 1's actual-60 handoff. Cook banked raw fish or begin the karambwan loop below until the skill tab reads actual 62. Use a range to reduce burns; the Lumbridge Castle range and cellar chest are already accessible through RFD's introduction. This is the first stop of one Cooking journey, not a separate method-panel checkbox.

quest_or_step: Complete Swan Song and open Piscatoris
requirements_and_form: 10 mist runes; 10 lava runes; 5 blood runes; 7 ordinary bones; 1 pot; 1 pot lid, new if One Small Favour consumed previous; 5 iron bars; 1 log; 1 tinderbox; 1 hammer (obtainable in quest); small fishing net obtained locally or brought; fresh monkfish caught during quest
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The pot and lid are separate from One Small Favour's hand-in. If no spare lidded pot remains, shape and fire one pot and one pot lid from two soft clay at Rimmington's pottery facilities; One Small Favour just unlocked the lid recipe. Smelt iron ore until five iron bars are ready, using the small-material suppliers . Buy a small fishing net from Gerrant and cut one ordinary log. Buy the five blood runes from a rune shop that actually stocks them, such as the Wizards' Guild once your current Magic reaches 66 (a Falador mind bomb can supply the access boost). The MTA purchase above closes missing mist/lava runes without a drop. If more MTA points are needed, refill law and nature runes at the Wizards' Guild, cosmic runes at Baba Yaga on the now-unlocked Lunar Isle, and the rooms' elemental runes at either shop; use the MTA room instructions from Chapter 1.4 and restore prayer/antipoison via the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before the queen.

quest_or_step: Build useful food stock and reach actual 70 Cooking
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Why 70: King Awowogei's RFD chapter requires it. The game allows a boost, but this route takes actual 70 so the requirement and a durable food stock are both solved. Check banked raw fish from Tempoross and other play first. Cook those before catching more; fish from ordinary Barbarian Fishing gutting is generally processed for its small Cooking XP rather than a promised raw-fish stock. Recommended relaxed loop: take the retained karambwan vessel and stackable karambwanji bait. Net more karambwanji at the Holy Lake near Tai Bwo Wannai, bait the vessel, fish raw karambwan at the north-east Karamja shore (fairy ring DKP nearby), bank a comfortable batch, then cook normally on a range. Select cooked/edible karambwan, not the poison preparation used during the quest. The Hosidius Kitchen offers a nearby bank and reduced burns if you independently completed the Easy Kourend & Kebos diary; do not assume that optional diary. The Lumbridge Castle range is the guaranteed low-burn fallback, with the RFD chest in the cellar. Expect burns and fish enough to cover them. No one-tick cooking is assumed. Wiki Ironman Cooking. Already-banked fish or ordinary leaping-fish gutting can fill the gap if you prefer; Fishing is already at least actual 65, so further fishing is for enjoyment, food or side XP, not a hidden Fishing gate. A more active cooking activity is optional if you enjoy it, but no click-intensive method is budgeted. Check live Cooking XP after each batch and stop only at actua...
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Verify 107 QP and start Legends' Quest for Kharazi access
requirements_and_form: Radimus notes from start; Machete; Axe; Charcoal and at least3papyrus for map, with failure spares; Vanilla pod collected in Kharazi for Sir Amik; full quest supplies are later
supplier_or_recovery_summary: If the bank lacks a machete, charcoal or papyrus, buy them from Jiminua's Jungle Store northwest of Tai Bwo Wannai . Bring at least three papyrus and spare charcoal/papyrus for failed mapping attempts, plus an axe. Radimus supplies his notes at the Legends' Guild; keep them after mapping. Collect the vanilla pod in the Kharazi Jungle now, and bank it for Sir Amik. This entry does not consume the later full-Legends gem, gold-bar or orb stock. That separate inventory is prepared at the completion step in 2.5.

requirements_and_form: 1 bucket of milk; 1 egg; 1 pot of flour; 1 cake tin
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count one bucket of milk, one egg, one pot of flour and a cake tin after earlier RFD cooking. The chest supplies the three food ingredients, and charter crews sell cake tins. Traiborn enchants this set during the quiz. Keep the tin for future baking; these milk/egg/flour purchases do not also cover Sir Amik's later mixture.

quest_or_step: Free Evil Dave with a measured spice stew
requirements_and_form: living cat/kitten follower; grown cat preferred; stews until 4 spices × correct doses found and final stew produced; variable count; spices obtained quest-local via rat catching
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy stews at the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village , or make them: put a potato and cooked meat into a bowl of water, then cook the uncooked stew on a range (25 Cooking). Buy a bowl or make one from soft clay, pick potatoes from the field north of Lumbridge, and cook beef from a cow. Refill failed/tested stews until your final recipe is ready. If the reserved cat was traded away, buy a replacement kitten from Gertrude for 100 coins . Feed and interact with it while doing other quests until it grows; there is no bank item or potion that skips its growth. Keep the grown cat for Icthlarin and A Tail of Two Cats in 2.6.

quest_or_step: Free Skrach Uglogwee with a cooked jubbly
requirements_and_form: 1 axe; 1 raw chompy; 1 iron spit (17 Smithing,1ironbar); 1 log; 1 tinderbox; 1 pickaxe; 1 ogre bellows; ball(s) of wool; ogre bow and ogre arrows; jubbly ingredients quest-local, repeat if burn
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Smith one iron bar into an iron spit at an anvil with a hammer (17 Smithing). The small-material suppliers covers ore, wool, tools and replacement ropes elsewhere. Shear and spin extra wool if repeated balloon-toad baits consume your last ball. Take replacement bellows from Rantz's cave chest and buy another ogre bow from Rantz if yours was lost. Remake arrows with achey logs, feathers and wolf bones using the earlier Chompy step. If the extra raw chompy was cooked or discarded, repeat that same bloated-toad hunting loop until one raw chompy is banked. Hunt another jubbly if the cooked quest bird burns.

quest_or_step: Free Sir Amik Varze; leave Legends only partly done
requirements_and_form: 1 axe; 1 machete +Radimus notes for Kharazi entry; 1 dramen/lunar staff; 1 raw chicken; 1 bucket of milk; 1 pot of cream; 1 pot of cornflour (mill one RAW sweetcorn with empty pot); 1 dramen branch (not cut staff); 1 vanilla pod; 1 pestle and mortar; ice gloves or already-owned Smiths gloves(i); anti-dragon shield recommended for Evil Chicken lair
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy one bucket of milk, one pot of cream and one raw chicken from the Culinaromancer's Chest. For the cornflour, pick one raw sweetcorn from the fields in Outer Fortis , south of Civitas illa Fortis, and take it with an empty pot to a working windmill. Put the corn in the hopper, operate the hopper controls and collect the cornflour below. A bowl of cooked sweetcorn is a different item. If no uncarved dramen branch remains, return to Entrana's dungeon tree. Bank prohibited equipment before taking the boat; kill dungeon zombies for an axe and cut a fresh branch. The completed Lost City fight need not be repeated. Keep your dramen/Lunar staff for Zanaris and crush the branch with a pestle and mortar for the cinnamon. The vanilla pod was collected during the Legends access step; recover another from the southwest Kharazi Jungle with axe, machete and Radimus notes if needed. Replace lost ice gloves through the Ice Queen route in Heroes' Quest and a missing anti-dragon shield through Duke Horacio. Refill the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before entering the lair.

quest_or_step: Free King Awowogei at actual 70 Cooking
requirements_and_form: M'speak amulet; 1 ordinary banana; 1 monkey nuts; 1 rope; 1 knife; 1 pestle and mortar; gorilla greegree; ninja greegree; zombie greegree; each missing greegree needs corresponding bones +1monkey talisman (1,000gp Tutab); quest-local snake corpse, red banana, tchiki nuts; extra sets if burn
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy the ordinary banana and monkey nuts from Solihib in Ape Atoll's market , and use them on the wise monkeys when asked. They lead to the red-banana/tchiki-nut correction; arriving only with the final special ingredients skips a required earlier interaction. Tutab's Magical Market sells blank monkey talismans for 1,000 coins each ; buy one for each missing gorilla, ninja and zombie greegree. Use the matching gorilla, ninja-monkey and zombie-monkey bones with those talismans at Zooknock: gorillas are temple guards, ninja monkeys guard the village, and zombie monkeys are in the temple basement. Rebank prayer and antipoison for the dungeon with the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery . If the M'speak amulet is lost, use the full MM1 amulet-replacement instructions . A missing Karamjan greegree needs a fresh monkey talisman and ordinary Karamja monkey bones at Zooknock. Use another retained greegree to trade with Tutab; if all disguises are missing, repeat the monkey child's lost-toy/talisman conversation from MM1 with M'speak equipped, using five garden bananas if requested. A missing ninja greegree later needs one new talisman plus bones from a ninja monkey guarding Marim, taken to the same Zooknock; the completed subquest does not remove that recovery route. Get a few snake corpses, red bananas and tchiki nuts for cooking retries; stop once one cooked stuffed snake is ready. Keep all three new greegrees afterward for later Ape Atoll quests.

quest_or_step: STOP: verify all council members and 175+ Quest Points
requirements_and_form: All eight RFD council rescues, Desert Treasure I and Horror from the Deep complete; 175+QuestPoints; Finale-specific actual food, ordinary restores, icegloves and combatgear
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Before entering the final portal, open the quest list. The four Chapter 1.3 credits (RFD introduction + Goblin, Dwarf and Pirate), the five members on this page, and the standalone prerequisites must all be complete. This route's guaranteed total is 201 QP before the finale, already well above the 175-QP requirement. The total comes from named mandatory quests only; optional Making Friends, full Legends and any miniquest are excluded. If your live total differs, compare it to the ledger's per-quest audit instead of doing random filler. Also verify Desert Treasure I and Horror from the Deep, both already finished, and prepare a bank of food, restores, ice gloves, Magic/Ranged gear and suitable runes. Your real post-2.3 Magic/Ranged and Hitpoints matter more than an assumed optional melee level. You can switch styles and restock between bosses.

quest_or_step: Defeat the Culinaromancer and buy Barrows gloves
requirements_and_form: ice gloves; ordinary restore potion(s) for Karamel; combat equipment and food; Prayer is disabled; 130,000gp for postcompletion Barrows gloves purchase, not quest hand-in
supplier_or_recovery_summary: At the bank before Karamel, count ordinary restore-potion doses , food and runes for a spell you can still cast after a stat drain. At 22 Herblore, each clean harralander + vial of water + red spiders' eggs makes restore(3); the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery supplies missing ingredients. Prayer potions do not repair those stats, and Prayer is disabled in these fights. Recover missing ice gloves from the Ice Queen before Flambeed. Rebuild the food bank with the karambwan fishing/cooking loop above if earlier attempts used it; return to the chest between bosses instead of budgeting one inventory for the entire sequence. Keep 130,000 coins separate for the gloves purchase after completion.

requirements_and_form: 1 bronze med helm; 1 iron chainbody; 1 ordinary cabbage (not Draynor Manor)
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy the bronze med helm from Peksa in Barbarian Village and the iron chainbody from Wayne in southern Falador . Pick a normal cabbage at the farm south of Falador or at Edgeville Monastery; Draynor Manor's cabbage does not work for this sabotage. Keep both armour pieces after the quest for King's Ransom. They are separate from the three black-armour pieces needed there.

quest_or_step: Complete Recruitment Drive; record its Herblore, Agility and Prayer XP
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Visit Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park after Black Knights' Fortress. Bank all equipment and inventory items for the Temple Knight trials; the rooms contain self-supplied puzzle items. Work through the five randomized tests and the Sir Leye fight as the quest directs. Completion gives 1,000.5 XP each in Herblore, Agility and Prayer. Claim and record them: the Herblore amount is part of the exact Legends checkpoint, and Prayer/Agility are real later inputs. Trial solutions.

quest_or_step: Complete Wanted! and record 5,000 Slayer XP
requirements_and_form: 20 unnoted rune/pure essence; 1 light source; 1 rope if cave entrance unroped; combat gear; 1 law rune +1 enchanted gem +1 molten glass OR10,000coins for commorb
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy an enchanted gem from any Slayer master , a law rune from the Wizards' Guild, and make one new molten glass from charter-shop sand and soda ash at a furnace. The small-material suppliers explains those suppliers and boosted Guild access. Hand all three to Tiffy, or use the explicit 10,000-coin alternative if you prefer. If the old essence was crafted, take a pickaxe to Aubury in Varrock and ask to teleport to the Rune Essence Mine . Mine until you have 20 rune/pure essence, bank it and withdraw it unnoted for the quest. Reuse the enclosed lantern from Tears; Miltog sells a replacement and the still supplies oil from swamp tar. Ned sells a replacement rope. Keep the commorb for The Slug Menace; Sir Tiffy replaces it if lost. Buy a spiny helmet from a Slayer master if you want protection when passing the swamp cave's wall beasts.

quest_or_step: Complete Temple of the Eye for Runecraft progress and Guardians access
requirements_and_form: 1 bucket of water; 1 chisel; 1 pickaxe; tutorial tools supplied locally; strong tea quest-local NPC dialogue
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy a bucket from Lumbridge's general store and fill it at a sink or fountain. Bring your own pickaxe/chisel for convenience; the tutorial can provide them if missing. The strong tea, amulet and incantation are obtained from the quest's NPC sequence, so they are not advance shop purchases. Keep the pickaxe and chisel afterward. Guardians of the Rift now provides a convenient way into the five altars The Slug Menace needs, without requiring you to own five talismans.

quest_or_step: Verify actual 30 Runecraft for The Slug Menace
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Chapter 1 left Runecraft around 24; Lunar Diplomacy alone did not guarantee 30. Read the actual skill-tab level after all 9,210 Temple XP. If it is still short because your starting XP differed, finish only the visible remainder with ordinary rune crafting or a few GOTR rounds: gather essence, craft at the opened altars, hand energy to the guardian and bank the runes. Stop at actual 30, the Slug Menace gate.

quest_or_step: Complete The Slug Menace and buy Proselyte
requirements_and_form: commorb, replaced by Sir Tiffy; 1 swamp paste; 5 rune/pure essence minimum;15–20 buffer for failed shaping; 1 chisel; Air/Water/Earth/Fire/Mind altar access; GOTR portals after Temple of Eye,30RC route floor
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy one swamp paste at Port Khazard's general store . Reclaim a missing commorb from Sir Tiffy. Mine rune/pure essence via Aubury as in Wanted!, then carve the quest's five blank runes with the chisel; failed carvings consume essence, so replenish until all five exist. The investigation supplies the dead sea slug and page fragments. With Temple of the Eye complete, join a Guardians of the Rift round and carry the quest blanks. As the air, water, earth, fire and mind Portal Guardians activate, enter the matching altar and use its quest blank on the altar. Their level checks are below your actual 30 Runecraft. Wait for a missing portal in a later round if needed; this is access to five altars, not a reward grind. Owned talismans/tiaras also work, and the Lunar altar-access preparation explains the Abyss alternative and its Wilderness entry. Keep 25,000 coins separate for Proselyte after the melee-only finale.

requirements_and_form: combat able to damage Slash Bash: default Crumble Undead (39Magic,2air+2earth+1chaos each cast) OR comp ogre bow +brutal arrows; quest-local portrait/tankard/herbs/etc; Relicym's balm recommended disease recovery after Sithik teaching; rogue's purse+vialwater+snakeweed,8Herblore
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Crumble Undead is a level-39 standard spell using two air, two earth and one chaos rune per cast ; Aubury sells those runes. Carry a sensible stack and a teleport for a failed attempt. If you choose Ranged, learn the comp ogre bow and brutal-arrow recipes from Grish and make that complete setup before Slash Bash, rather than assuming the old chompy kit works. After transformed Sithik Ints explains the cure, make Relicym's balm at 8 Herblore: rogue's purse + vial of water + snake weed . Search the speckled fungus in Karamja's Pothole Dungeon for rogue's purse and the marshy vines southwest of Tai Bwo Wannai for snake weed, the same plants used in Jungle Potion. Show/sell a finished balm to Uglug Nar outside Jiggig ; his unlocked shop sells more three-dose balms, so buy replacements before the boss. Antipoison does not cure disease. The backpack supplies a knife and tankard; Sithik's furniture supplies the portrait paper/charcoal. Extra paper can be taken from his drawers if the portrait fails. The strange potion and gate key are obtained through the investigation.

quest_or_step: STOP: verify actual 45 Herblore without a potion grind
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The conservative route floor is 37,224 XP at actual 40. Add Heroes' Quest 1,325, both One Small Favour lamps 20,000, Recruitment Drive 1,000.5, and Zogre 2,000: 61,549.5 XP. Level 45 begins at 61,512 XP, so the mandatory route clears it by 37.5 XP even with no incidental potion-making. Check the skill tab. If below 45, find an unclaimed named quest reward or lamp; do not conceal a missing reward with an invented grind.

quest_or_step: Finish Legends' Quest and put all four rewards into Herblore
requirements_and_form: Radimus notes (incomplete acceptable for initial access; completed map for full quest); 3 papyrus minimum + failure spares; 1 charcoal minimum + spare supply; QH variable charcoal3 actually quantity1; 1 machete; 1 rune or dragon axe; rune shop default; 2 gold bars minimum + failure extras; 1 hammer; 1 rope; lockpick(s), may break; 1 pickaxe; 1 vial of water; 1 ardrigal; 1 snake weed; 1 each cut sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond, opal, jade, red topaz; wall runes:1 soul +1 mind +1 earth +2 law; unpowered orb + runes for Charge Orb; route stocks2 orbs/2 casts (6 cosmic+60earth) for repeat entry buffer; combat supplies
supplier_or_recovery_summary: If the partial start ended before the bullroarer, use your completed Radimus notes on a Jungle Forester to receive one; the same interaction replaces a lost one. Radimus replaces his notes. Jiminua sells machete, charcoal and papyrus. Buy a rune axe from the Woodcutting Guild shop if no suitable axe is banked; the quest's stated axe requirement should be checked before entering. Count one cut opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire, emerald, ruby and diamond . Mine Shilo's surface gem rocks and cut gems until each missing type is present; replace crushed low-tier gems rather than assuming One Small Favour left seven intact types. Buy gold ore from Ordan and smelt at least two gold bars , with more if the gold-bowl attempt needs a retry. Buy ordinary lockpicks from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den , whose 50 Agility/Thieving access is already met; Ned supplies rope. Make two new unpowered orbs from two molten glass with a glassblowing pipe (46 Crafting): the 1,590 old orbs were charged and alched. For the supported Charge Earth Orb choice, take six cosmic and 60 earth runes for two possible gate casts, plus the separate wall offerings of one mind, one soul, two law and one earth rune . Baba Yaga sells cosmic/elemental runes after Lunar; the Wizards' Guild sells law/soul runes. Use the standard spellbook. Buy a vial of water from Jatix in Taverley. Obtain ardrigal from the palms on northeast Karamja and snake weed from the marshy vines southwest of Tai Bwo Wannai during the quest. R...

quest_or_step: Complete Ghosts Ahoy; keep the Ectophial
requirements_and_form: ghostspeak amulet; 31 ecto-tokens without Charos or20with; route prepares35; 400+coins (travel/ship payments); 1 bowl of nettle tea; 1 bucket milk kept separate until Old Crone's porcelain cup; 1 silk; 1 knife; 1 needle+thread; dyes to match three flag colours; get3each primary colour for all variants or buy observed deficit; 1 spade; 1 strung oak longbow; 1 bucket slime for disguise, separate from slime used to earn tokens
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Pick nettles while wearing gloves , for example near Edgeville's yews. Add them to a bowl of water and heat the bowl on a range. Bring that nettle tea and a separate bucket of milk; the Old Crone provides the porcelain cup, then asks for milk after the tea is in her cup. An ordinary cup of tea or Guthix rest is not this recipe. Count your slime now: a zero-token plan using seven offerings needs seven buckets for 35 tokens plus one separate bucket for the ghost disguise . If the earlier ten are gone, take empty buckets down to the Ectofuntus slime pool and refill them. Kill chickens for ordinary bones and buy pots for the bonemeal; each additional offering replaces five spent tokens. Reclaim a lost ghostspeak amulet from Father Urhney in Lumbridge Swamp. Inspect the ship's flag colours before buying only the needed dyes. Aggie in Draynor makes red from two redberries, yellow from two onions, or blue from two woad leaves , plus five coins each; Wyson in Falador Park sells two woad leaves for 20 coins. Mix primary dyes if a flag needs a secondary colour. Three of each primary covers any three-colour combination if you prefer a buffer. Buy silk in Al Kharid, needle/thread at Dommik and a strung oak longbow from Lowe in Varrock.

Read actual Fletching after Chapter 1 and Zogre's 2,000 XP; Sins requires actual, unboosted 60. If still below 50, bridge the high-40s with willow longbows or the existing arrow-making supplies. At 50, switch to banked-maple shortbows; at 55, maple longbows become available. Use a knife and ordinary Make-X. If your kingdom's teak stock for Construction is healthy, temporarily move its five non-herb workers from teaks to maples for passive logs/nests; no daily collection schedule is assumed. If no maple stock has accumulated, cut maples north of Seers' Village bank with your axe; 45 Woodcutting is already covered. Below 50 Fletching, cut willows at Draynor for the willow-longbow bridge. Make only enough logs/bows to close the live XP gap, without waiting for a scheduled kingdom collection. Stop when the skill tab reads 60. Fletching methods.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Complete Haunted Mine and make a Salve amulet
requirements_and_form: combat supplies; quest-local glowing fungus transported via minecart; postquest Salve crafting:1chisel+1ballwool and crystal cut locally
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy a chisel from a general store and spin one ball of wool at Lumbridge if the previous quests used yours. The glowing fungus inside the mine supplies the light for its deeper section: follow the mine-cart transport puzzle, because an ordinary lamp does not replace it there. Take food, a working teleport and the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery for Treus Dayth. After the fight, the crystal outcrop supplies replacement salve shards if you later need another amulet; each replacement still needs its own wool.

quest_or_step: Complete Lair of Tarn Razorlor and enchant the Salve amulet
requirements_and_form: combat supplies; Tarn's diary obtained after boss; Salve amulet recommended/recoverable
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The miniquest has no outside puzzle-material shopping list. Carry your Salve amulet for the diary upgrade, or cut another shard in the completed Haunted Mine and string it with fresh wool. Tarn's diary is collected in the room beyond the fight. Refill food, antipoison and prayer doses through the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before committing to the maze.

quest_or_step: Complete In Search of the Myreque
requirements_and_form: 1 steel longsword; 2 steel swords; 1 steel mace; 1 steel warhammer; 1 steel dagger; 225 steel nails; 6 regular planks; 1 hammer; 5 druid-pouch charges minimum; collect extra to cover ghasts; 10 coins OR ring of Charos (a)
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The weapon set costs nine steel bars : longsword two, two swords one each, mace one, warhammer three and dagger one. Buy iron/coal from Ordan and smelt the deficit. The small-material suppliers supplies six regular planks and 225 steel nails ; these are separate from the planks and nails consumed by earlier bridges and Cold War. Charge the druid pouch to at least five , with extra for ghasts on the journey: use Bloom on a blessed silver sickle near Mort Myre's rotten logs, twigs and bushes , collect the resulting plants and fill the pouch. Restore Prayer and repeat until the charge count is sufficient. If the pouch or blessed sickle is gone, return to the Nature Spirit's grotto; make a replacement silver sickle from one silver bar and a sickle mould if needed, then have it blessed. Keep the delivery weapons distinct from your own combat weapon. Bring the charged pouch, silver weapon, food, ten coins and a teleport for the actual swamp trip.

quest_or_step: Complete In Aid of the Myreque; use the 15 banked salmon
requirements_and_form: 1 food item for the chest, plus spares if a ghast eats it; 1 spade; 1–5 empty buckets; 1 pickaxe; 1 hammer; 11 regular planks; 44 nails; 2 swamp paste; 10 raw mackerel OR 10 raw snail meat as assigned; 10 bronze axes; 4 tinderboxes: 3 for hand-in, 1 retained; 2 steel bars; 1 coal; Silver weapon or accepted alternative; new silver sickle needs an additional silver bar; 1 soft clay; 1 rope; 1 silver bar for rod; 1 mithril bar; 1 cut sapphire; 1 cosmic rune; 1 water rune; 15 cooked salmon for the chosen safer Ivan escort; optional steel armour is separate
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Bring one spare food item for the entry chest , then stage the repairs at the bank. Buy 11 regular planks and 44 nails via the small-material suppliers ; buy buckets/tinderboxes from a general store and two swamp paste at Port Khazard . Four tinderboxes means three for the shop hand-in plus one to light the furnace. Keep two steel bars and one coal separate for that furnace. Buy ten bronze axes from Bob in Lumbridge , waiting for stock or changing worlds if needed. After learning the food request, big-net fish at Catherby until you have ten raw mackerel , or kill Mort Myre snails for ten raw snail meats if that is the requested option. Cooked fish cannot satisfy this hand-in. Carry a silver weapon for the Gadderanks/vampyre section. If your silver sickle is missing, use one additional silver bar and Dommik's sickle mould at a furnace (18 Crafting) to make another; this bar is separate from the rod's bar. For the rod, mine one silver ore at Al Kharid and smelt a bar; buy one mithril ore and four coal from Ordan and smelt the mithril bar. Make fresh soft clay, mine/cut a sapphire at Shilo if missing, buy rope from Ned and the two enchant runes from Baba Yaga. Follow the quest's mould/coffin construction with these actual materials. If the 15 salmon were eaten or otherwise spent, fly-fish at Lumbridge's river or Shilo with a fly-fishing rod and feathers from Gerrant; keep and cook salmon until 15 cooked ones are banked. They are Ivan's escort food, in addition to your own. Hi...

quest_or_step: Reach actual 60 Attack and use the dragon scimitar
supplier_or_recovery_summary: After In Aid's combat XP and any Slayer work, read the live skill tab. Train only the shortfall to actual 60 Attack. This makes the dragon scimitar unlocked by Monkey Madness I in 2.2 usable as a normal melee weapon. Use ordinary Slayer assignments first; if a short gap remains when you want the weapon, the relaxed Gemstone Crab or another low-attention target is fine. The route does not assume the optional Chapter 1 combat branch.

quest_or_step: Reach Attack + Strength ≥130 for the Warriors' Guild
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Add your actual Attack and Strength levels. After Attack 60, train Strength only until the sum reaches at least 130; this often resembles 60/70, but extra quest or Slayer XP may make an exact 70 Strength unnecessary. Prefer task combat; if Slayer gets to 50 first, finish only this remaining sum at Gemstone Crab or another relaxed training spot. Players who did optional 65/65/65 can skip any targets already met.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 60 Defence to equip the dragon defender
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Read Defence after In Aid and ordinary combat. Train only the remainder to actual 60, preferably while progressing Slayer; use a low-attention combat spot if task RNG leaves a gap. The guild can be entered by the Attack + Strength sum, but the dragon defender itself cannot be equipped below 60 Defence.

quest_or_step: Earn and keep the dragon defender
supplier_or_recovery_summary: A steel full helm, steel platebody and steel platelegs use ten steel bars at an anvil: two, five and three respectively. Actual 50 Smithing already clears the highest recipe, so smelt only missing bars from Ordan's iron/coal. A med helm or chainbody does not complete this set. Recover the armour after each animated kill. If a piece is destroyed, remake that piece before the next animation. The guild food shop can replace food while you work on tokens and defenders; the drop endpoint still determines how many trips you need.

quest_or_step: Complete Darkness of Hallowvale; allocate all three choices to Herblore
requirements_and_form: 1 hammer; 2 regular planks; 8 nails; 1 knife; Sketch papyrus/charcoal and miner pickaxe are quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy or make the two regular planks and eight nails using the small-material suppliers . Keep your hammer and knife through the city section. A miner can provide a pickaxe if you are sent to the mines, and the quest supplies the charcoal and papyrus for its castle sketches; you do not need another bulk jungle-mapping purchase. Bank and refill food and ordinary restores through the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before the dangerous scouting. Keep the rod of Ivandis from In Aid for the continuing chain.

quest_or_step: STOP: reach actual 54 Agility for A Kingdom Divided
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Darkness may help but does not guarantee actual 54 from the route's prior Agility floor. Check the skill tab and train only the remaining XP. The recommended lower-input course is the basic Colossal Wyrm Agility Course (opens at 50) at the Colossal Wyrm Remains in the Avium Savannah, Varlamore. Travel via Varlamore's roads or an available transport, speak to Worm Tongue at the course, then follow the scaffolding obstacles for a complete lap. Termites are scooped automatically at some obstacles and can buy small rewards; blessed bone shards are a Prayer bonus, not a required bone-budget input. The August 2026 course adjustment lengthened laps and scaled XP/rewards to keep a similar pace with fewer inputs. Course and access map. Falador rooftop is the level-50 alternative: start at its southern wall, finish the rooftop loop and collect marks of grace as available. Neither Hallowed Sepulchre nor Brimhaven is required. Stop at actual 54.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Complete A Kingdom Divided; use both lamps on Herblore
requirements_and_form: 1 axe; 1 volcanic sulphur; 1 defence potion(3) or (4), kept at that dose count; 1 molten glass; 1 dark essence block: mine dense block with pickaxe/chisel, use Dark Altar; Fire Bolt or better: minimum 3 air, 4 fire and 1 chaos rune per cast; Melee gear for Judge of Yama; other combat gear/food
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Your Warriors' Guild access is now guaranteed: buy one defence potion(3) from Lilly inside the guild. Keep all three doses for the quest's mixture; a one- or two-dose leftover is insufficient. This closes the need without assuming a ranarr or whiteberries survived earlier potion-making. Mine one volcanic sulphur in Lovakengj with a pickaxe; a face mask from a Slayer master helps with the clouds. Mine one dense essence block in Arceuus with a pickaxe and chisel, then use it on the Dark Altar to make the dark essence block. The actual Mining/Crafting gates are already met. Make one new molten glass from charter sand/soda ash if the bank has none. Pack runes for Fire Bolt or better ; the simplest Fire Bolt cast needs three air, four fire and one chaos rune, all sold by Aubury. Bring the melee gear required by the melee-only fight and bank between encounters. Refill the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery and food for the final section.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 65 Defence for King's Ransom
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Use your dragon scimitar/defender on ordinary Slayer assignments where reasonable, training Defence only until the skill tab reads actual 65. If Slayer reaches its next gate first, use Gemstone Crab or another relaxed target for only the remaining Defence XP. Do not train 65→70 yet: King's Ransom and Knight Waves award Defence XP that would otherwise be overshot.

quest_or_step: Complete King's Ransom; send the lamp to Herblore
requirements_and_form: 1 lockpick OR 1 law + 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab; 1 granite, any size; Black full helm, black platebody and black platelegs; 1 bronze med helm; 1 iron chainbody; 1 Animate rock scroll
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Reclaim the Animate rock scroll from Wizard Cromperty in East Ardougne during the quest if you kept no copy after One Small Favour. Mine one granite of any size at the quarry south of the Bandit Camp with your pickaxe; bring desert water for the trip. This is granite, not a granite weapon or limestone. The black full helm and platelegs are sold by Valaine in the Champions' Guild, and black platebody by Horvik in Varrock. Phoenix Gang players may not have bought them for Heroes; Black Arm players must still replace any lost pieces. Recover the bronze med helm from Peksa and iron chainbody from Wayne if Black Knights' Fortress gear was discarded. Take an ordinary lockpick from Martin Thwait, or one law and one air rune for Telekinetic Grab on the standard spellbook. The knights can also help provide a lockpick inside. None of these purchases changes the existing quest order.

quest_or_step: Complete Knight Waves and claim all four combat rewards
requirements_and_form: Melee gear; Food; Ordinary restore potions for repeated stat drain; Attack/strength potions recommended; Lilly supplies them; QH's poisoned weapon is strategy advice rather than a mandatory gate; it is not imposed
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count the actual ordinary restore-potion doses remaining after the Culinaromancer and Morytania fights. At 22 Herblore, a harralander + vial of water + red spiders' eggs makes restore(3); use the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery to replace missing ingredients. Prayer potions do not restore drained Attack/Strength/Defence here. Lilly's Warriors' Guild shop sells three-dose attack, strength and defence potions if you want cheap combat boosts; take separate restore potions for repeated drains. Refill strong food with the 2.4 karambwan loop or the guild food shop, and retry in manageable attempts.

quest_or_step: Complete A Taste of Hope; keep the medallion and flail
requirements_and_form: 1,000 coins; 1 vial of water; Rod of Ivandis; 1 cut emerald; 1 chisel; Lvl-2 Enchant: 1 cosmic + 3 air runes, or tablet; Combat gear; Silver sickle, herb, sanguine vial and fountain water are quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: If the rod of Ivandis was lost, speak to Vertida in the new Myreque base during the quest, then get a replacement from Veliaf in Burgh de Rott . Mine and cut gems at Shilo until you have one emerald if the bank lacks it. Buy the cosmic/air runes from Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle and use Lvl-2 Enchant on the standard spellbook . The base's northwest crate provides a blessed silver sickle for the upgrade. The laboratory supplies its mysterious herb, vial and pestle and mortar, and the broken fountain can fill the vial. Bring the separate vial of water and 1,000 coins in the preflight so the quest's other requests are covered. Refill the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before Ranis.

quest_or_step: Calculate from live Prayer XP, gather bones in batches, reach actual 70
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Why: Piety needs actual 70 Prayer, not an inherited 1,300-green-dragon task. First claim Recruitment Drive and Ghosts Ahoy Prayer XP, read your current Prayer XP, and subtract it from the level-70 threshold. Dragon bones give 72 base XP. The Wilderness Chaos Altar gives 350% per offering and a 50% chance not to consume that bone; each starting bone therefore yields 504 expected XP over repeated offerings. Plan ceil(XP still needed ÷ 504), subtract dragon bones already banked, then add a sensible buffer for altar RNG, deaths and mistakes. 504 is an expectation, not a guarantee. Recheck live XP after each batch and stop at actual 70. Chaos Altar mechanics. Safe/default bone supplier: Isle of Souls blue dragons. Use fairy ring BJP on the north coast, run south-east to the dungeon, and find the blue-dragon room's cove by the adamantite rocks (check the map before engaging). Attack from behind the terrain with Water spells or Ranged; bring an anti-dragon shield/dragonfire protection for travel and any approach mistakes, food, runes/ammo and a teleport. Prioritize dragon bones; hides are optional value, not a Crafting dependency. Bank at the Soul Wars lobby via its minigame teleport or another convenient bank, then return via BJP. The dungeon guide marks the safespot. Split collection across sessions around quests and Slayer. At the altar: the Wilderness risk is real even if the bones came from safe dragons. Use disposable gear and small, unnoted one-inventory trips; bank your v...

quest_or_step: STOP: reach actual 50 Slayer before Sins
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Check the skill tab after Royal Trouble's 5,000 XP in 2.3, Wanted!'s 5,000, Tarn's 5,000 and every ordinary task you chose between this chapter's blocks. Train only the remaining XP to actual 50 with regular assignments; no cannon, bursting, expensive skips or optimized task block list is assumed. Do not insist on 51 yet—that level belongs after Sins and before Troubled Tortugans.

quest_or_step: Close the remaining Defence gap to actual 70 and unlock Piety
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Knight Waves is complete and its 20,000 Defence XP has already been claimed, as has King's Ransom's 33,000. Read live Defence now; train only the remaining gap to actual 70 through Slayer or a relaxed combat spot. With actual 70 Prayer from the preceding bone block and Knight Waves complete, Piety is unlocked. This is the chapter's major combat milestone: Barrows gloves, Helm of Neitiznot, dragon scimitar (or best available weapon), dragon defender, Proselyte where Prayer bonus matters, and Piety are a solid guaranteed baseline. Optional fighter torso or berserker ring is not assumed.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 60 Herblore before Sins, then stop
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Why grind now? Sins rewards a tome with six 15,000-XP choices in a skill at level 60 or above, and all six can go to the same skill. Reaching actual 60 before claiming it lets Herblore receive 90,000 XP. The minimum guaranteed accounting, counting RFD's lamp exactly once, is 37,224 XP at the level-40 floor + 1,325 Heroes + 20,000 One Small Favour + 1,000.5 Recruitment + 2,000 Zogre + 120,000 Legends + 20,000 RFD + 5,000 King's + 20,000 A Kingdom Divided + 6,000 Darkness + 7,500 A Taste = 240,049.5 XP. Level 60 begins at 273,742 XP, so this floor leaves 33,692.5 real Herblore XP—roughly 34k—before any live potion XP. If the RFD lamp was used earlier on Herblore, it still counts once; if it was used on another skill despite the route, add that missing 20k back to the live gap. Read live Herblore XP and make only the remaining XP in potions your account will use, from banked herbs/secondaries, kingdom herbs and Farming Contract or herb-run supplies. Prioritize useful combat/prayer/antipoison potions rather than stockpiling an arbitrary herb count. Stop at actual 60; the later level-70 SotE requirement is not this chapter's grind. Herblore method reference.

quest_or_step: Complete Sins of the Father; put all six tome choices into Herblore
requirements_and_form: Ivandis flail; 1 cut ruby; Lvl-3 Enchant: 1 cosmic + 5 fire runes, or tablet; QH's display text mistakenly says 3 air but the actual variable is 5 fire; 1 axe; 1 knife; 1 chisel; Vyrewatch top, legs and shoes OR 1,950 coins; Combat food/prayer; small iron-knife stack recommended; Drakan's medallion is recommended transport; Kael/Ivan/Perdu recovery included
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy missing Vyrewatch top, legs and shoes from Trader Sven in southern Meiyerditch near Old Man Ral's house, for 1,950 coins for the complete set. This is the earlier shop disguise; the quest later provides its separate noble disguise. If the Ivandis flail is missing, buy another from Vertida in the Myreque base for 20,000 coins . Mine/cut a ruby at Shilo if earlier Legends/jewellery used the last one. Buy one cosmic and five fire runes from Baba Yaga, use the standard spellbook for Lvl-3 Enchant , and take axe, knife and chisel. The base's crate supplies another silver sickle and the quest provides access to the Blisterwood tree; those are quest-local ingredients. Bring a small stack of iron knives from Martin Thwait's Rogues' Den shop for the summoned bloodveld, instead of relying on random black knives from the defender grind. Refill food, prayer doses and useful combat potions using the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery before Vanstrom, and repeat that bank check after an unsuccessful attempt. Lost Drakan's medallion: before the final story sequence, Kael Forshaw can replace it in the old Myreque Hideout beneath the northern room of Old Man Ral's Meiyerditch house. After Sins of the Father, speak to Ivan Strom there instead . If the quest's current phase makes the free supplier unavailable, Perdu's Lost Property Shop sells a replacement for 30,000 coins ; Perdu stands by Lumbridge Castle's southern wall. Bank a spare before Vanstrom if you want simple return tr...

Sins itself is not an 8,000-Slayer-XP reward; that reward comes after Troubled Tortugans. Read actual Slayer and finish only the remaining XP to 51 with ordinary tasks. This is an unboostable Tortugans entry gate, not a general push toward a higher Slayer level.

quest_or_step: Complete Troubled Tortugans and unlock the Great Conch
requirements_and_form: 1 axe; 1 hammer; 1 saw; all three can be obtained locally; Combat gear; Food; Prayer restoration; Shield parts are quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Bring your axe, hammer and saw if banked. If missing, The Summer Shore has a bronze axe to the west , a hammer in the northeast smith's house , and a saw in Elder Raley's southeast house . A better owned axe speeds the cutting; no new axe grind is required. The island story supplies the seaweed, palm leaf and Tortugan-shield components. Finish that shield and equip it before the gryphon. Check food, a teleport and the potion recipes and missing-stock recovery immediately before the fight, rather than assuming the doses used at Vanstrom still exist.

quest_or_step: Complete Icthlarin's Little Helper; record Agility
requirements_and_form: Cat or kitten follower; 1 tinderbox; 1 full waterskin(4) held for the hand-in, plus travel waterskins; 600+ coins; 1 bag of salt OR a bucket to obtain quest saltwater; 1 linen OR 30 coins for Raetul; 1 willow log; 1 bucket of sap
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Check the live bank even if Chapter 1 once collected sap. Use a knife on an evergreen tree with an empty bucket to collect another bucket of sap; the evergreens outside Falador work. Cut a willow log at Draynor, buy one bag of salt from a Slayer master , and buy full waterskins/desert clothing at Shantay Pass. A knife spawns in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen, and its general store supplies a bucket and tinderbox. Buy linen from Raetul in eastern Sophanem for 30 coins when the burial preparation needs it. The 600-coin travel/payment buffer covers this; linen is a quest purchase, not ordinary cloth or silk. Bring your living cat/kitten; if missing, buy another kitten from Gertrude for 100 coins. Use the prayer and antipoison recovery if the bank has no doses.

quest_or_step: Complete A Tail of Two Cats; use both lamps on Herblore
requirements_and_form: Cat or kitten follower; 1 catspeak amulet; 5 death runes; 1 whole chocolate cake; 1 ordinary log; 1 tinderbox; 1 bucket of milk; 1 shears; 4 potato seeds; 1 rake; 1 seed dibber; 1 vial of water; Desert shirt and desert robe; Doctor/nurse hat is provided during the quest
supplier_or_recovery_summary: At 50 Cooking , use a chocolate bar on a whole cake to make the chocolate cake. Steal the cake from an Ardougne cake stall and buy the chocolate bar and milk from the Culinaromancer's Chest; a part-eaten cake is not the hand-in. Buy the five death runes from Aubury. Buy four potato seeds from Olivia in Draynor , and missing rake/dibber from Sarah's Farming shop south of Falador. Shantay sells the desert shirt and desert robe ; take the actual two clothing pieces, not generic desert protection. Jatix supplies the vial of water. Cut the log and replace shears/tinderbox at Lumbridge's general store. If the catspeak amulet was lost, ask the Sphinx in Sophanem for another; recover a kitten from Gertrude if needed. The quest provides the doctor/nurse hat during its disguise sequence, so there is no outside hat purchase.

quest_or_step: Finish Fairytale II; put its lamp into Herblore
requirements_and_form: 1 dramen or lunar staff; 1 vial of water; 1 pestle and mortar; Food/combat equipment; Nuff's certificate is recoverable locally; Star flower from CKP and Gorak claw from DIR; 49 Farming and 57 Herblore
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Search Fairy Nuff's room in north-west Zanaris for another Nuff's certificate if it is no longer banked, and read it before repeating the ring-code sequence. A missing dramen staff can be remade with the Lunar preparation's Entrana method ; buy a vial of water and pestle and mortar from Jatix. The potion ingredients are quest-local : pick a star flower on the CKP plane when it grows, and obtain a claw from a Gorak on DIR . At 57 Herblore, put the star flower in the vial of water and add the claw crushed with the pestle and mortar. This is magic essence , not a potion made from the ordinary herb stock.

Mourning's End Part I eventually needs actual 60 Ranged, but do not do the whole gap at once. Check live level after earlier quest rewards; train only to actual 50. Gemstone Crab in the Tlati Rainforest is a relaxed, long-idle target; Ammonite or Sand Crabs work too. For cheap Ironman ammo, buy a Dorgeshuun crossbow and bone bolts from Nardok in the Dorgesh-Kaan mine, accessible after The Lost Tribe; the shop stocks the crossbow and inexpensive bolts/packs. Use the earlier arrow stock instead if preferred. Shop stock.
