If the arrows were used, buy the shortfall from Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock . If the attractor itself is missing, bring 999 coins plus 75 steel arrows to Ava for the accumulator at actual 50 Ranged. The retained attractor replaces the 999-coin payment when you still have it.

quest_or_step: Complete Dream Mentor; put the dreamy lamp into Ranged
requirements_and_form: Seal of passage; 20 food pieces: 7 of one type, 7 of a second, 6 of a third; 1 goutweed; 1 astral rune; 1 hammer; 1 pestle and mortar; 1 tinderbox; Special dream vial supplied by the quest; Separate high-healing food for four bosses; Prayer disabled
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Cyrisus needs three distinct food types. For a simple refill, catch/cook seven salmon, seven tuna and six lobsters : fly-fish salmon at Lumbridge/Shilo and fish the sea types at Catherby with a harpoon and lobster pot from Gerrant. Cook until the required successful counts are banked. Use other suitable banked food types if you already have them; keep your high-healing boss food separate. If Eadgar's Ruse used the last goutweed , steal another from the Troll Stronghold kitchen storeroom using its guard-avoidance route. This is not a gout tuber. Buy the astral rune from Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle , and ask Brundt in Rellekka for a replacement seal of passage. Fill the quest-provided dream vial and follow the goutweed/ground-astral sequence; an ordinary shop vial does not replace it. Before entering the dream, refill high-healing food with the established Tai Bwo Wannai karambwan fishing/cooking loop. There is no prayer-potion requirement for the dream itself because Prayer is disabled; the four-boss food supply must survive that sequence.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 65 Agility; make an Agility potion
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Read the post-Icthlarin level. At the Colossal Wyrm Remains in Varlamore's Avium Savannah, continue the basic course until actual 62, then use its advanced course through actual 65. The August 2026 longer-lap update reduced inputs while scaling rewards, making it a good lower-input default; Seers rooftops are an alternative once actual 60 is reached; use Falador rooftops before that if you prefer them. Hallowed Sepulchre, unlocked by Sins, is a more active option, not an assumed method. Count live Agility-potion doses: use the four-dose bottle reserved during Tai Bwo Wannai Trio preparation if it remains, or refill the shortfall through 2.4's Brimhaven Agility Arena toadflax (three vouchers per herb), vial of water and Gnome Stronghold swamp toad's legs recipe. A banked or farmed toadflax is fine, but the variable Master Farmer/patch branch is not the required supplier. Do not count Trio's consumed bottle again. The potion gives +3 Agility, so 65 + 3 = 68 for Making Friends. No Summer pie is required. Course details.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Complete Eagles' Peak as a quest break
requirements_and_form: 1 yellow dye; 1 swamp tar; 50 coins; 10 eagle feathers collected locally; Azyff makes 2 beaks and 2 capes
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Make yellow dye at Aggie in Draynor with two onions and five coins , or use one still banked. Pick up one swamp tar in Lumbridge Swamp. During the quest collect ten eagle feathers in the Eagles' Peak caves; take these, the dye, tar and 50 coins to Azyff in Varrock's Fancy Clothes Store for two fake beaks and two eagle capes. The metal feather, coloured puzzle feathers, odd bird seed and ferret-catching equipment are supplied in the quest area. The first completion does not require a pre-purchased rope or a stock of Hunter bait.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 71 Mining; buy a dwarven stout
supplier_or_recovery_summary: From the actual-60 Lunar checkpoint, train only the live gap to actual 71. Shooting Stars are the relaxed option; Motherlode Mine is the resource-focused option because its ores can feed Smithing. A normal dwarven stout gives +1 Mining and can be bought from the Rising Sun Inn in Falador; 71 + 1 = 72 at the Making Friends check. This also clears Song of the Elves' unboosted 70 Mining gate. If you strongly prefer avoiding level 71 and accept RNG, actual 70 plus a successful +2 orange-spice stew is optional; it is not this route's default. Boost reference.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Complete Making Friends with My Arm; open Weiss
requirements_and_form: 1 saw; 1 bolt of cloth; 5 mahogany planks; 1 cadava berries; 1 hammer; 1 tinderbox for the fire phase; 1 bucket of water, 1 rope and 1 pickaxe, all available locally; Agility potion +3 from actual 65 and normal dwarven stout +1 from actual 71 Mining for this route's boosts; Combat food/prayer
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy the bolt of cloth for 650 coins from the Varrock sawmill operator . Check for five mahogany planks still present after the lectern and Cold War; if short, cut the missing mahogany logs north of the Farming Guild and convert them at a sawmill for 1,500 coins each . The full five cost 7,500 coins in conversion fees. Buy ordinary dwarven stouts from the Rising Sun Inn in Falador for the +1 Mining check. The Trio preparation gives the repeatable toadflax/toad's-legs recipe for the Agility potion(4) . Carry enough doses/drinks to repeat checks if a boost expires; the previously reserved potion is not guaranteed to survive earlier use. Replace hammer/tinderbox/bucket at Lumbridge's general store, saw at the sawmill, rope from Ned, and pickaxe from Nurmof in the Dwarven Mine if needed. Refill combat supplies through the potion supply note before the fight.

quest_or_step: Sail from the live post-Tortugans level to actual 52
supplier_or_recovery_summary: After Troubled Tortugans, use The Summer Shore notice board for courier tasks: accept a delivery, pick up the crate at its ledger, put it in your cargo hold, sail to the destination and deposit it at the receiving ledger. Choose available routes rather than forcing one perfect loop. Chart newly reachable water/landmarks for one-time XP and salvage when you want a different texture. Bring routine food/repair supplies where your route crosses danger. Stop at actual 52 Sailing; do not count Troubled Tortugans' 10,000 XP twice. Current training guide.

quest_or_step: Complete The Red Reef; bank its Sailing and Smithing XP
requirements_and_form: Ranged/Magic combat gear OR a boat with cannons and ammunition; Land combat gear; Food/prayer recommended; QH recommends 5 boat repair kits; the guide's 300-HP reserve uses 10 mahogany kits at 30 HP each; Deep sea helmet and apparatus supplied by the quest
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The Magic/Ranged crew-kill route avoids needing a cannon upgrade or cannonball stock. Use the combat equipment you already own. The quest supplies the deep sea helmet and apparatus for its dive; these are not the earlier RFD diving items. For the roughly 300-boat-HP reserve, make ten mahogany repair kits (30 repair each) at a shipwright's workbench , using its mahogany-kit recipe; your actual 62+ Construction clears the 47 requirement. Bring hammer and saw. Refill the recipe's mahogany planks by cutting logs north of the Farming Guild and paying a sawmill 1,500 coins each; make mithril nails at an anvil from mithril bars (Ordan's mithril ore plus four coal per bar), and buy swamp paste from Shipwright Seb or the Port Khazard general store . Make only the live kit shortfall, checking the workbench's required quantities before buying a batch. Repair kits heal the boat, not your character. Bank fresh food and prayer potions for the land fights as a separate supply check.

quest_or_step: Reach actual 52 Hunter with live birdhouse XP counted
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Check the skill tab after Eagles' Peak and any birdhouses. For a deterministic catch-up, travel to the Hunter Guild in Varlamore and speak to Guild Scribe Verity in the Burrow. At actual 46, Huntmaster Gilman gives Novice Hunters' Rumours: receive an assigned creature, bring the normal trap/tools for it, hunt until its rare part appears, then return it for Hunter XP and a loot sack. Assignments and rare-part timing vary; consult the creature/trap reference as needed, with no block-list meta required. No particular task or number of birdhouses is assumed. Stop temporarily at actual 52 for Defender.

Count the 5,000 Smithing XP from The Red Reef and check live XP. Use Giants' Foundry for the resource-efficient default: bring banked metal bars to the foundry south of Al Kharid, cast a sword in the mould, then work its heat/shape stations as the progress markers direct. Use banked-bar smithing for a simpler anvil loop, or Blast Furnace gold with the Family Crest goldsmith gauntlets if you want a faster active alternative and have ore. Stop at actual 55; Defender then gives 15,000 more XP. Foundry primer.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Verify actual 35 Runecraft; no new grind is expected
supplier_or_recovery_summary: The named, mandatory rewards alone are 1,000 Enter the Abyss + 6,000 The Eyes of Glouphrie + 500 The Ascent of Arceuus + 5,000 Lunar Diplomacy + 9,210 Temple of the Eye + 3,500 The Slug Menace = 25,210 Runecraft XP, even ignoring all starting/training XP. Level 35 starts at 22,406 XP and level 36 at 24,742 XP, so the route actually guarantees at least actual 36 before What Lies Below's 35 gate. Verify that each quest reward was claimed and read the skill tab. If a named quest is somehow incomplete, finish/claim it first; if the actual account still shows below 35, use only the visible remainder via a few Guardians of the Rift rounds. This is a dependency check, not an automatic grind.

requirements_and_form: 1 empty fired bowl; 15 chaos runes; Chaos Altar access; GOTR Guardian of Chaos needs actual 35 Runecraft and Temple of the Eye; Folder, papers, wand and letters are quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Buy 15 chaos runes from Aubury . Make an empty bowl from one soft clay at the Rimmington pottery wheel, then fire it in the pottery oven (8 Crafting); this is a fired bowl, unlike Dragon Slayer's unfired one. Rat and Surok provide the folder, letters and metal wand during their steps. At 35 Runecraft , enter a Guardians of the Rift game and use the active Guardian of Chaos portal when it appears. Take Surok's wand and all 15 chaos runes to the altar and charge the wand there. Temple of the Eye is complete, so this route needs no chaos talisman or new Wilderness access; no extra rune essence is needed for the wand charge.

quest_or_step: Complete Defender of Varrock; claim its museum lamp
requirements_and_form: Combat gear and food; Pickaxe; available in the quest, with Nurmof as fallback; Bottle, barronite deposit, chaos core and shield-forging items are quest-local
supplier_or_recovery_summary: No outside bar, ore or gem hand-in is required. The quest supplies its mist bottle and other story items. In Camdozaal , mine the required barronite deposit and fight a chaos golem for a chaos core when instructed, then use the quest's forge process. Bring a pickaxe you actually own; Nurmof in the Dwarven Mine sells replacements. The retained Salve is recommended combat equipment. If it is missing, use the Haunted Mine preparation to replace the crystal and wool, then Tarn's diary for its enchantment. Refill food and prayer doses before the zombie fights.

Count the actual 2.1 endpoint (at least 62), Darkness of Hallowvale's 2,000 Construction XP, Making Friends' 10,000 XP, and any real contract/shipbuilding XP. Use the plank sack and Adept Mahogany Homes with kingdom teaks and remaining 2.1 planks first. If neither is stocked, repeat 2.1's ordinary teak-cutting and sawmill loop; the Castle Wars tree works when Fossil Island trees are unavailable. Refill steel bars from Ordan's iron ore and coal, so kingdom collection timing cannot block actual 70. From the conservative actual-62 floor, the two named quest rewards leave roughly 390,000 XP to level 70; at an average around 280 total XP per teak plank in Adept contracts, roughly 1,400 teaks is a planning scale, not an exact bill. Starting above 62, varying contracts and banked planks move this substantially: think roughly 1,000–1,500 teaks total from the conservative start, and prepare/top up in smaller batches rather than chopping a rigid total. Faster POH furniture uses more planks but remains a choice. Once the remaining plank need is comfortably covered, non-herb kingdom workers can switch to maples or coal. Stop at actual, unboosted 70. Contract reference.
Preparation and material/level handoff reviewed in this page; use the named consumer's detailed record.

quest_or_step: Return to Sailing; pause at actual 60
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count The Red Reef's 15,000 Sailing XP and sail from the observed level. Rotate ordinary Summer Shore courier deliveries with new charting and salvage rather than repeating one loop until 67. Stop at actual 60: camphor-era ship facilities begin to matter around here, and this is a useful pacing break, not a Song of the Elves gate. Keep any camphor gathered in the Sacred Grove for later ship work.

quest_or_step: Finish actual 60 Ranged for Mourning's End Part I
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count earlier Ranged quests, the Dream Mentor 15,000-XP lamp and actual training; read live XP. With the accumulator equipped, return to Gemstone/Ammonite/Sand Crabs and train only the remaining gap to actual, unboosted 60. The cheap Ironman default is Nardok's Dorgeshuun crossbow plus bone bolts; buy bolts/packs in manageable batches as the stack runs down. Existing bows/arrows are fine. Stop at 60, not 62 for the deferred Curse of Arrav.

quest_or_step: Finish actual 70 Hunter with rumours as the catch-up
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Read live Hunter after Eagles' Peak's 2,500, Defender's 15,000 and whatever birdhouse XP actually happened. Continue the Hunter Guild loop. At actual 57, ask Cervus or Ornus for Adept rumours; they use the same assigned-creature → rare-part → return loop but a different task pool and better loot sacks. You may keep a comfortable Novice task if preferred. Birdhouses remain a convenient background lane, never a required number of runs. No chinchompa mega-grind or task block list is assumed. Stop at actual, unboosted 70. Rumour tiers.

quest_or_step: Complete Making History and claim the museum lamp
requirements_and_form: 1 spade; 1 unenchanted strung sapphire amulet: 1 gold bar + 1 cut sapphire + amulet mould, then 1 ball of wool, at 24 Crafting; 1 ghostspeak amulet; No ecto-token payment after Ghosts Ahoy
supplier_or_recovery_summary: At 24 Crafting , use one gold bar, one cut sapphire and an amulet mould at a furnace, then add a ball of wool . Hand in this strung sapphire amulet without enchanting it ; an amulet of magic is not the requested item. For a missing bar buy gold ore from Ordan and smelt it; mine/cut a sapphire at Shilo until you have one. Buy the mould from Dommik in Al Kharid and shear/spin wool at Lumbridge, or buy a ball from Aemad in East Ardougne. Father Urhney replaces a ghostspeak amulet, and a spade spawns at the Falador estate agent.

quest_or_step: Finish actual 70 Agility after the quest rewards
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Count Icthlarin's 4,000 XP, training to actual 65 and Making Friends' 50,000 XP; check the skill tab. Continue the advanced Colossal Wyrm course as the lower-input default. Hallowed Sepulchre is an active alternative now that Sins is complete; neither its higher floors nor 72/77/84/98 Agility are mandatory. Stop at actual, unboosted 70.

quest_or_step: Sail to actual 63; decide whether to build the Bosun's Bench
supplier_or_recovery_summary: Another short courier/charting/salvage return reaches actual 63 Sailing. With 54 Construction already exceeded and the Red Reef schematic unlocked, the Bosun's workbench becomes available. Its current live recipe is 6 camphor planks, 24 adamantite nails and 5 lead bars, with a saw/hammer and the quest schematic. A crewmate assigned to it uses repair kits from the cargo hold to repair the boat automatically. You may wait until the deterministic adamantite-nail preparation after Smithing 70 below; do not grind rare salvage just to build it at 63. Build it only if you expect enough ship combat to value the automation; ownership is optional and creates no progress checkbox. Facility recipe.

Check actual Smithing after the 55 checkpoint, Red Reef's 5,000 and Defender's 15,000 XP (do not double-count Reef if it was already included before 55). From exactly level 55 before Defender, its reward alone leaves about 560,000 XP to level 70; higher starting XP and real bar work lower that. At Giants' Foundry, sword XP varies with alloy and performance, so budget against the live XP gap and banked bars, not a promised number of MLM inventories. Process ore from Motherlode Mine or other banked sources into bars; refill with ores/metal equipment only as needed. Ordinary anvil smithing is simpler; Blast Furnace gold plus goldsmith gauntlets is a faster, more active alternative if gold ore is available. Stop at actual, unboosted 70, not BRUHsailer's 74. Do not miss the ship-nail dependency: the skiff hull needs 300 adamantite nails, normally smithed at 74. At actual 70, buy two or three Kovac's grogs from the Giants' Foundry reward shop (300 reputation each; do a few commissions if you trained by another method). Each gives a deterministic +4 Smithing; use the boost at an anvil to turn 20 adamantite bars into 300 nails (15 per bar), redrinking before it decays. Smelt the bars at actual 70 from 20 adamantite ores and 120 coal or use bars already banked. If you also want the optional workbench, budget two extra bars for 30 more nails; it uses 24.
